_meta.spec: EMCA Decision Engine tox.json - built on the OVCA_Decision_Engine_Spec_v0.1 §6 task 1 conventions (data/tox.json of the OVCA repo)
_meta.hard_rule_3: Unreported fields are the literal string "not_reported". No estimation, no inference, no carry-over from model knowledge of the trial. Every number is copied from the structured extract; no PDF was needed (every extract used has a toxicity section).

field_conventions.grade3plus_any_pct: ANY-CAUSE grade >=3 rate. Where a source reports only TREATMENT-RELATED grade >=3, the any-cause field is "not_reported" and the TRAE figure is carried in treatment_related_grade3plus_pct. Where G3 and G4 (and G5) are worst-grade-per-patient categories their sum is exact and is stored with "derived_sum": true (GOG-249). Where G3 and G4 are per-category or the overlap is not stated (GOG-0283, pazopanib), they are NOT summed. Older trials printing a per-patient 'grade 3-4 toxicity' rate without stating attribution (JGOG-2033) are carried here with that caveat in notes. Severity scales that are not CTCAE grades (ASTEC mild/moderate/severe; PORTEC-1 Franco-Italian glossary) are not mapped to G>=3. A G3-4 rate is treated as G>=3 only where the source states no grade 5 / no treatment-related deaths.
field_conventions.treatment_related_grade3plus_pct: Grade >=3 AEs attributed to treatment (TRAE), or explicitly treatment-related complications. A lower bound for any-cause. Immune-related-only G>=3 rates are not used here (notes only).
field_conventions.dose_reduction_pct: A true dose-reduction rate. 'Dose modification', 'interruption', or 'reduction or discontinuation' figures are "not_reported" with the figure in notes. Per-drug reductions without a patient-level rate are given as a string. In multi-drug regimens the drug reduced is named in notes (e.g. lenvatinib, olaparib).
field_conventions.discontinuation_pct: Discontinuation due to adverse events / toxicity. Where the source mixes toxicity and refusal, or uses a non-safety-population denominator, the value is a string saying so. TRAE-only discontinuation is labelled.
field_conventions.arms: Randomised trials carry every arm under 'arms', keyed by a short arm label; top-level fields describe the experimental arm (a string listing each experimental arm where there are several). Two single-arm trials with separate cohorts (GARNET by MMR status) also carry them under 'arms'. Arm 'n' is given where the safety denominator differs by cohort.
field_conventions.evidence_quote: Verbatim text from the source extract; several fragments are joined by ' || ', each fragment verbatim (checked programmatically against the file).
field_conventions.label: '<name as in the note> (<first author> <year>)'; other files match on the part before ' ('. One entry per trial, however many notes/tables list it; extra extracts of the same trial are in additional_sources.

_meta.coverage: All randomised and single-arm trial rows with a structured extract in the four EMCA v1.2 algorithm notes (endometrioid, serous, clear cell, carcinosarcoma), all settings. Each trial placed once, in the table of its main setting (trials listed in both Table 2 and 3A sit in Table 2; GOG-0261 sits in Table 1 where the carcinosarcoma note carries its main row). Rows where the note marks the histotype as excluded (TROPiCS-03, ADAGIO and GARNET in the carcinosarcoma note) are still included because the trial itself is relevant to other histotypes.
